metadata.title: Mk0 Bootstrapper: Scrap-Stack Mechanics
metadata.notes: The lowest-level on-ramp for the local pilot. Visceral, tactile, and immediately useful.

nodes.title: \u{26A0} Kinetic & Chemical Safety (MANDATORY)
nodes.description: Zero-entry requirement. Identify fire extinguisher locations, demonstrate proper Li-ion cell handling to prevent thermal runaway, and master the 'Dead Short' multimeter test. Soldering irons remain locked until this node is mastered.

nodes.title: The Mycelial Lantern (Entry Point)
nodes.description: The first step of the Sovereign Quickening. Salvage a battery cell, wire a solar charger, and provide light to your pod. MASTERING THIS UNLOCKS: 1.0 TEND + 1 hour of 3D printer time.

nodes.title: Washing Machine Teardown (Copper Recovery)
nodes.description: Harvesting high-value materials from 'e-waste'. MASTERING THIS UNLOCKS: 2.0 TEND + access to the Scrap Metal Commons.

nodes.title: ESP32 & The Mesh Handshake
nodes.description: Your first digital node. Flash an ESP32 and see your harvested energy appear on the local dashboard. MASTERING THIS UNLOCKS: 5.0 TEND + entry to the Professional Technician track.

nodes.title: The Warehouse Steward Capstone
nodes.description: Maintain a physical metabolic loop for 7 days. Performance is verified by IoT sensors. COMPLETION DIVIDEND: 20 TEND + 'Citizen' trust tier elevation + physical key to the Community Greenhouse.

holonic_capstone.deliverable: 7 days of telemetry data showing positive energy/nutrient balance, verified by the 'Isibaya' (Genesis Cohort).

edges.rationale: SAFETY FIRST: You cannot handle battery cells without passing the safety node.
SAFETY FIRST: Motor teardown requires sharp tool and magnetic safety training.
You must build the lantern before you can connect it to the mesh.
Material recovery is a prerequisite for long-term warehouse stewardship.
Completing the Mk0 capstone qualifies you for the Solar PV Technician track.
